status: Final root source decisions; publication requires three complete language reports and build checks.

edits.reason: An interest-rate level is a percentage, not a percentage-point difference.
edits.zh: 利率是 5% 的时候，这两件事之间隔着一整个行业。
edits.en: At an interest rate of 5%, an entire industry lies between them.

edits.reason: Eligibility does not guarantee instant or unrestricted redemption; do not make unsupported lifetime predictions about a small holder.
edits.zh: 对具备资格、满足最低规模的客户，它是一条按条款和银行处理条件运作的通道；账户正常、银行开门、赎回没有暂停，都很要紧。对只持有几百美元的人，至少在这个余额规模下，他还不能直接走这条通道。
edits.en: For an eligible customer meeting the minimum size, it is a channel operating under the terms and banking arrangements—not an unrestricted promise of instant payment. Account standing, bank availability, and any redemption suspension matter. Someone holding only a few hundred dollars cannot use that direct channel at that balance size.

edits.reason: Tether's eligible verified customers are not necessarily institutions; direct redemption remains conditional.
edits.zh: 要说的只是那句话的准确范围。直接按面值赎回，要满足资格、规模、费用和处理条件，并不是任何持有人随时都能兑现。具备这些条件的客户可以参与一级套利；其余持有人主要享受到的，是这批客户套利之后留在二级市场上的价格。
edits.en: The point is the promise's exact scope. Direct redemption at par depends on eligibility, size, fees, and processing conditions; it is not available to every holder at any moment. Customers meeting those conditions can conduct primary-market arbitrage. Other holders mainly benefit from the secondary-market price that arbitrage helps maintain.

edits.reason: Specify the announced first complete annual financial-statement audit, not absence of every possible audit engagement before it.
edits.zh: 在 2026 年8 月13 日那份公告之前，较准确的说法是：Tether 尚未宣布完成这样一次完整年度财务报表审计，公开的季度储备鉴证不能代替它。
edits.en: Before the August 13, 2026 announcement, the precise point was that Tether had not announced completion of this kind of full annual financial-statement audit. Its public quarterly reserve attestations were not a substitute.

edits.reason: Do not turn review of the available historical quarterly documents into a universal claim about every past/future period.
edits.zh: 而把这里讨论的季度储备鉴证逐份称为公司的完整财报审计，仍然不准确。
edits.en: Calling the quarterly reserve attestations discussed here full audits of the company's financial statements remains inaccurate.

edits.reason: Revenue sharing depends on balance location and contract categories; it is not identical for every USDC regardless of location.
edits.zh: 按这套分成安排，连放在两个平台之外的生态余额，也可能让一部分净储备收益流向 Coinbase，而持有人未必知道这条分配路径。币在哪里、谁持有，和储备收益最后分给谁，并不是同一本账。
edits.en: Under this arrangement, even balances held outside the two platforms can send part of net reserve income to Coinbase, through a path holders may not know about. Where tokens sit and who holds them are different questions from who ultimately shares their reserve income.

edits.reason: Maturing assets or repo funding do not necessarily increase outright Treasury sale supply.
edits.zh: 大额赎回，发行人需要现金，可以等待资产到期、用回购融资，或者卖出短债。只有出售这一路直接增加了市场上的卖盘；其他路径的影响，要看资金安排和当时的流动性条件。
edits.en: Large redemptions require cash, which issuers may obtain by waiting for assets to mature, using repo funding, or selling short-term debt. Only the last directly adds outright selling pressure; the other routes depend on funding arrangements and liquidity conditions.

edits.reason: The FDIC proposal includes extensions in specified scenarios, not an exception-free two-business-day maximum.
edits.zh: 那份拟议规则还提出每月公开储备构成，列出资产类别、平均期限和托管地；赎回原则上不超过两个工作日，而重大赎回等特定情形可以向 FDIC 申请延长。
edits.en: The proposed rule also calls for monthly reserve-composition disclosures showing asset categories, average maturity, and custody location. Redemption would generally take no more than two business days, with specified situations such as significant redemption requests permitting an application to the FDIC for an extension.

edits.reason: The one-token proposed minimum expressly remains subject to screening and onboarding.
edits.zh: 以及一条：最低赎回规模不能高于一枚稳定币，但仍须完成适当的筛查和开户程序。
edits.en: And one further provision: the minimum redemption amount may not exceed one stablecoin, still subject to appropriate screening and onboarding.

edits.reason: Limit the non-interest-bearing fixed-par claim to the reserve-backed payment coins discussed, not every algorithmic or yield-bearing stablecoin.
edits.zh: 这里讨论的法币储备型支付稳定币，把约定面值的赎回和储备收益权分开：持有代币本身，通常不赋予分享那笔储备利息的权利。这不能概括所有算法型、超额抵押型或另附收益安排的稳定币。
edits.en: The reserve-backed payment stablecoins discussed here separate redemption at a stated face value from rights to reserve income. Holding the token itself generally does not confer a share of that interest. This is not a description of every algorithmic, overcollateralized, or separately yield-bearing stablecoin arrangement.

edits.reason: Do not erase the other asset classes shown in the same reserve table.
edits.zh: 变的是它背后那一美元买了什么。2021 年 Tether 的储备里近一半是商业票据；到本文采用的 2026 年资料，国库券和回购占了主要部分，同时仍有黄金、比特币、贷款等其他资产。
edits.en: What changed is what the backing dollar bought. In 2021, almost half of Tether's reserves was commercial paper. In the 2026 material used here, Treasury bills and repos formed the main part, alongside gold, bitcoin, loans, and other assets.

edits.reason: A fixed contractual face value is not a permanently one-dollar market price or a universal on-chain balance field of one.
edits.zh: 没有随储备收益一起增加的，是约定的一美元赎回面值，而不是说市场价格永远等于一美元，或链上每个余额字段永远写着 1。
edits.en: What does not rise with reserve earnings is the stated one-dollar redemption face value—not a market price guaranteed to remain one dollar, or an on-chain balance field permanently reading 1.

edits.reason: Distinguish durable gas metering framework from error-free opcode pricing.
edits.zh: 给执行计量和设限的那套框架，后来成为这条链长期沿用的部分，具体价目表却仍要不断修订。而给决策定规矩的这套 The DAO，只运行了不到两个月。
edits.en: The framework for metering and bounding execution became a lasting part of the chain, while its specific price schedule still required revision. The DAO's system for governing decisions operated for less than two months.

edits.reason: Zero transferred value does not imply near-zero gas fees; CALL and callee execution consume resources.
edits.zh: 上一篇写过 gas 那套机制怎样给执行的每一步定价。它量的是执行所耗的资源，不是转账金额。金额为零的调用仍然要消耗 gas，接收方继续执行的代码也会产生成本。付了这些费用，不代表控制权交出去以后就安全：攻击者要的恰恰不是那笔零额奖励，而是重新进入分割函数的机会。
edits.en: The previous essay described how gas prices each execution step. It measures resources consumed, not the amount of money transferred. A zero-value call still consumes gas, and code executed by the recipient adds costs. Paying those fees does not make handing over control safe: the attacker wanted not the zero-valued reward, but an opportunity to reenter the split function.

edits.reason: Carry forward EP02's narrowed public-records claim, not absence of all labor recording institutions.
edits.zh: 第二篇的结尾说过，电和钱在那批公开材料里有清楚的位置，人的工作和处境却没有被同样完整地呈现。
edits.en: The second essay ended with electricity and money clearly represented in those public materials, while people's work and circumstances were not presented with the same completeness.

edits.reason: Pseudonymous addresses do not supply a comprehensive reliable identity map; off-chain identification is still possible.
edits.zh: 这里又进一层：钱记得精确到最小单位，而仅凭链上的地址，无法可靠地还原所有参与者的身份。
edits.en: Here the gap goes further: money is recorded to the smallest unit, but on-chain addresses alone cannot reliably reconstruct every participant's identity.

edits.reason: Do not equate pseudonymous participation with a guarantee of complete anonymity or universal impossibility of identifying anyone.
edits.zh: 不必先出示现实身份，就能以地址参与，是这套设计的重要选择。它不保证任何人在任何情况下都不被识别，却意味着出了事以后，链上也不会自动交出一份完整的受损者名册。要找回人，仍然需要链外的材料和当事人的配合。
edits.en: Allowing participation through addresses without first presenting a real-world identity was an important design choice. It did not guarantee that no one could ever be identified. It meant that after a failure, the chain would not automatically supply a complete list of people harmed. Finding those people still required off-chain information and their cooperation.

edits.reason: Unclaimed balances are observed; the future intentions or survival of all claimants are not known.
edits.zh: 也可能有人再也不会来。哪些人还会来，单凭那些余额无法断定。
edits.en: Some may never come. The balances alone cannot tell us who will return.

edits.reason: Frame never-returning claimants as a possibility, not an established complete population.
edits.zh: 不是没有被记录的钱，而是钱已经记下，仍然长期没有出现的权利人。其中可能有永远不会再来的人，但我们不能从一个未领取的地址直接断言他是谁、为什么没来。
edits.en: It is not unrecorded money. The money is recorded, while the rights holders remain absent for years. Some may never return, but an unclaimed address alone does not tell us who they are or why they have not come.

edits.reason: The governance gap is compatible with protocol-valid records, not proof of a perfect chain history.
edits.zh: 两件事有一个共同点：转账和余额可以按链上规则核验，而缺的那一部分，并不会因此自动从链外出现。
edits.en: The two situations share something: transfers and balances can be checked against on-chain rules, but doing so does not automatically supply the missing off-chain part.

edits.reason: Governance must address long-unclaimed property while leaving future rights intact, without pretending all future nonclaims are known.
edits.zh: 于是一次为了退款而做的干预，十年之后还没有结完，并且自己长出了一个新的治理问题：怎么处理长期没有人来领的链上财产，同时又为将来可能出现的权利人保留申领的门。
edits.en: An intervention made to provide refunds thus remains unsettled ten years later and has grown a new governance problem: how to handle long-unclaimed on-chain property while keeping the door open to rights holders who may still appear.

edits.reason: The standard leaves matters outside its scope; some projects and legal institutions do address them, unevenly.
edits.zh: 问题出在后来：接口之外那份清单，要由项目、合同和制度另行接住，而它们做到的程度并不一致。接口统一了，不等于这些安排也有了统一的保障。
edits.en: The problem came later: projects, contracts, and institutions had to take responsibility for the list outside the interface, and did so unevenly. Standardizing the interface did not standardize the protection supplied by those arrangements.

edits.reason: Do not describe non-ERC20 matters as an absolute legal vacuum.
edits.zh: 两头之间那一大段东西，不在 ERC-20 标准里，需要每个项目另行安排。团队选择做到什么程度是一回事，合同义务和现行法律是否要求它做到，是另一回事，不能因为标准没写就一并抹掉。
edits.en: The large stretch between them falls outside ERC-20 and needs separate arrangements in each project. What a team chooses to provide is one question; what contracts and existing law require is another. Neither disappears simply because the standard does not prescribe it.

edits.reason: These are different and overlapping samples, not necessarily disjoint sets.
edits.zh: 这一轮浪潮的规模，至少有三组口径不同的数字，采用的样本和时段并不完全一致。
edits.en: The scale of this wave has at least three sets of figures using different measurement bases, with samples and periods that do not fully coincide.

edits.reason: June26 2017 to June1 2018 is nearly a year, not exactly a full year.
edits.zh: Block.one 的 EOS 销售从 2017 年6 月26 日持续到 2018 年6 月1 日，将近一年；公开出售 9 亿枚代币换 ETH，另保留 1 亿枚给创始人；平均销售价格约 4.40 美元一枚。9 亿乘以 4.40 的简单算术约是 39.6 亿美元，而 SEC 的命令本身没有把这个算式宣布为精确的实际美元本金，它用的表述是所得的 ETH 当时价值数十亿美元。
edits.en: Block.one's EOS sale ran for nearly a year, from June 26, 2017, to June 1, 2018. It publicly sold 900 million tokens for ETH and reserved another 100 million for founders, at an average sale price of about $4.40 per token. Multiplying 900 million by $4.40 gives roughly $3.96 billion, but the SEC order did not declare that arithmetic an exact dollar principal received. It said the ETH proceeds were then worth billions of dollars.

edits.reason: Keep the duration comparison consistent with the actual nearly-year-long dates.
edits.zh: 三小时和将近一年。这两个销售在同一个年份里启动，用同一套标准，发的是同一类可替代代币。
edits.en: Three hours and nearly a year. Two sales beginning in the same year, using the same standard, issuing fungible tokens of the same general kind.

edits.reason: ERC20 interface compatibility does not make complete sale/token contracts identical.
edits.zh: 就 ERC-20 规定的那一层接口而言，它们都能提供同样的六个函数、两个事件；这不等于完整的发行合约和融资安排没有区别。
edits.en: At the interface level specified by ERC-20, both could expose the same six functions and two events. That did not make their complete issuance contracts or financing arrangements identical.

edits.reason: The standard interface does not itself encode full sale, identity or product terms; additional contracts can encode time/whitelist rules.
edits.zh: 只读这套标准接口，不能据此知道销售用了三小时还是一年、买家是什么身份、背后有没有产品。实际项目可以另外写入时间、白名单和锁仓规则；但读出余额、完成转账，并不等于那些安排已经被核实。
edits.en: Reading this standard interface alone cannot tell us whether a sale took three hours or a year, who the buyers were, or whether a product existed. A project can separately encode timing, whitelists, and lockups. Reading a balance or completing a transfer does not verify those additional arrangements.

edits.reason: Choices before purchase are not proof of unconditional post-purchase exit, as the next section explains.
edits.zh: 这里可选是存在的，买家可以不参加；可退出却还要看锁仓、挂牌和流动性。先看可算这一项：一份没有里程碑释放、没有独立托管、没有治理权，而且产品还不存在的安排，买家真正能核实和计算的东西，其实非常少。
edits.en: Choice existed: buyers could decline to participate. Exit still depended on lockups, listing, and liquidity. First consider calculability: under an arrangement with no milestone releases, independent custody, or governance rights, and no product yet, buyers had very little they could actually verify and calculate.

edits.reason: A promise not enforced by smart-contract code may still have contractual or other legal force.
edits.zh: 可算这一条因此要打折扣。折扣、分配、锁仓写在白皮书里，看上去可算；但相当一部分没有得到代码自动执行的保证。它们是否另有合同和法律上的约束，还要继续核查，不能把纸上的数直接当作已经锁住的资产。
edits.en: Calculability therefore needs a discount. White-paper discounts, allocations, and lockups appeared calculable, but many lacked automatic enforcement in code. Any contractual or other legal constraints still had to be examined; a number on paper could not simply be treated as assets already locked.

edits.reason: Sample averages do not show that most holders in every market have lower costs than a particular buyer.
edits.zh: 而在一些早期持有人以更低成本拿到代币的市场里，这个前提比它看上去更脆弱。
edits.en: In markets where some early holders obtained tokens at lower cost, that condition was more fragile than it looked.

edits.reason: Listing fees are not automatically illegal, but listing/issuance can fall under existing law; no blanket legal clearance.
edits.zh: 这一层的性质要说清楚。收取挂牌费不等于自动构成违法，也不等于有关发行和交易就不受现行法律约束。这里能看到的是两家机构之间的商业条件，而公开材料并没有给出一张可以逐项核对的统一价目表；其中一方掌握着另一方能不能被大量人买到的那道门。
edits.en: The nature of this layer matters. Charging a listing fee is not automatically unlawful, but neither does it place issuance and trading outside existing law. What is visible here is a commercial condition between institutions, without a uniform public fee schedule that can be checked item by item. One party controls a gateway through which the other's token can reach large numbers of buyers.

edits.reason: Off-chain listing does not lie outside every regulator's jurisdiction.
edits.zh: 而它决定的事情很实在。一个项目募到了钱，却未必能进入有流动性的交易场所；买家能不能卖、按什么价格卖，都还没有着落。上币的商务条件通常不完整地出现在链上或白皮书里；相关法律义务又要另行判断，而这一步会深刻影响前面那些承诺能否兑现。
edits.en: The consequences were tangible. Raising funds did not ensure access to a liquid trading venue; whether buyers could sell, and at what price, remained unsettled. Listing's commercial terms were usually not fully visible on-chain or in the white paper, while applicable legal duties needed separate analysis. This step could profoundly affect whether earlier promises became usable.

edits.reason: The following list contains six document categories, not five.
edits.zh: 六个案子，几种不同性质的文书：调查文件、和解的行政命令、初步禁令、和解、简易判决，以及最终判决。
edits.en: Six cases, documents of several different kinds: an investigative report, settled administrative orders, a preliminary injunction, a settlement, summary judgment, and final judgment.

edits.reason: Compatibility enables integration; not every wallet/exchange/contract supports every token automatically.
edits.zh: ERC-20 规定了六个函数和两个事件。它让兼容的钱包、交易所和合约可以沿用同一套接口，去读余额、处理转账和管理授权；是否实际支持某枚代币，还要看各自的实现和选择。
edits.en: ERC-20 specifies six functions and two events. Compatible wallets, exchanges, and contracts can reuse the same interface to read balances, process transfers, and manage approvals. Actual support for a particular token still depends on their implementations and choices.

edits.reason: The standard itself does not supply the omitted protections; other contracts and institutions sometimes do, unevenly.
edits.zh: 而它没有规定的那份清单，谁拿多少、锁多久、钱由谁保管、承诺怎样执行、这东西到底值不值，并不会因接口统一就自动补齐。有些项目另用合约和制度接住，有些只留下文字，做到的程度很不一样。
edits.en: The list it does not prescribe—who receives how much, lockup periods, custody, enforcement of promises, and value—does not fill itself in because the interface is standardized. Some projects add contracts and institutions; others leave words on paper. Their degree of protection varies greatly.

edits.reason: A widely used interoperable interface is not a guarantee of zero implementation failure in its history.
edits.zh: 钱包读余额、交易所支持代币、合约彼此调用，这些接口功能今天仍在广泛运转。这说明对接标准确实有用，不说明每一次实现都不会出错，也不说明接口之外的承诺已经兑现。
edits.en: Wallets reading balances, exchanges supporting tokens, and contracts calling one another still operate widely. That shows the value of a shared interface—not that every implementation is error-free, or that promises outside the interface have been fulfilled.

edits.reason: Observed mining share is not a headcount of natural-person miners.
edits.zh: 7 月20 日，区块 1,920,000 执行了那次状态变更。基金会称分叉平稳，最初观察到约 85% 的挖矿活动支持分叉链；这不是对矿工自然人数的清点。
edits.en: On July 20, block 1,920,000 executed the state change. The Foundation described the fork as smooth and initially observed roughly 85% of mining activity supporting the forked chain—not a headcount of individual miners.

edits.reason: Keep mining share and observation window distinct from headcount and permanent allocation.
edits.zh: 算力方面，分叉当天基金会观察到的初始支持比例约为 85%。这不是矿工人数的比例，也只能作为分叉初刻的量级，不能推导出 ETC 永久拥有 15% 的算力，因为矿工随后可以随价格和难度不断切换。
edits.en: The Foundation observed initial mining support of roughly 85% on fork day. That was not a proportion of individual miners, nor a permanent allocation: it does not establish that ETC would always retain 15% of hash power, since miners could subsequently switch with prices and difficulty.

edits.reason: Calculability, choice and exit are conditions for assessing risk, not a proof of fair allocation.
edits.zh: 而这四个数字放在一起，可以和第二篇那三条对一次。矿池那一层讨论过的可算、可选、可退出，是判断风险怎样分配的条件，不是只要具备就能保证公道。
edits.en: Together, these four figures can be compared with the second essay’s three conditions. Calculability, choice, and exit at the mining-pool layer help assess how risk is allocated; their presence alone does not guarantee fairness.

edits.reason: Retain the reported window: 90 days after the sale ended, not after listing.
edits.zh: 把这个数和上一节那条链接起来读：私募以折扣拿到筹码，公开销售提供了大部分资金，而在销售结束后的 90 天里，样本中平均近一半的投资者地址已经卖出了一部分。
edits.en: Read this alongside the previous sequence: private-sale investors acquired discounted tokens, public sales supplied most funding, and within 90 days of the sale ending, on average almost half the investor addresses in the sample had sold some tokens.

edits.reason: Do not reduce a fact-specific securities ruling to a universal counterparty-awareness test.
edits.zh: 在这份判决里，买方是否知道自己在向谁购买，是法院区分交易情境的一个因素；但法律上的定性仍要看交易的具体事实和经济关系，不能压成一条适用于所有代币的单项测试。
edits.en: In this ruling, whether buyers knew whom they were buying from was one factor in distinguishing transaction settings. Legal characterization still depends on the particular facts and economic relationship; it cannot be reduced to a single test for every token.

edits.reason: The next paragraph says methods define the denominators; the loss occurs in retelling.
edits.zh: 这一节合起来说的是同一件事：回报、存活、参与人数，这三样在这个域里看上去都可以精确到小数点后一位，而每一个数字底下都压着一个转述时很容易被省掉的分母和口径。
edits.en: Together, this section makes one point: returns, survival, and participation can all look precise to a decimal place, while each rests on a denominator and definition easily dropped in retelling.

edits.reason: State the fee-free idealization before using the constant-product equality.
edits.zh: 在先不计手续费的模型里，池子中两种资产的数量相乘等于一个常数。交易者往池里加进一些甲，合约允许他取走的乙，必须让这个乘积保持不变；实际收费版本还要作手续费调整。
edits.en: In the model before fees, the quantities of the two assets in the pool multiply to a constant. A trader adds some of asset A and may withdraw only enough B to preserve that product; the fee-charging implementation requires an adjustment.

edits.reason: Price impact is not all LP net profit; subsequent arbitrage and inventory valuation matter.
edits.zh: 差的那约 9% 不全是手续费，手续费只有千分之三；主要差别来自这笔交易沿曲线移动造成的价格冲击。池子的库存组合因此改变，但不能把这整个差额都算成 LP 的净利润：外部价格、后续套利和库存估值还会改变结果。
edits.en: That roughly 9% difference is not all a fee: the fee is only 0.30%, while most of the difference is price impact from moving along the curve. The pool’s inventory changes, but the whole gap is not LP net profit; external prices, subsequent arbitrage, and inventory valuation still matter.

edits.reason: Approximate inputs do not support spurious decimal precision; growth differs from end/start.
edits.zh: 按这两个约数算，期末借款量是期初的约 5,263 倍，增幅约为 52.6 万%。它量的是 BAT 的原生币数量，不是净流入的美元本金。
edits.en: Using those rounded figures, outstanding borrowing ended at roughly 5,263 times its starting level—an increase of about 526,000%. This measures BAT units, not net inflows of dollar principal.

edits.reason: Remove an assertion of exact precision contradicted by rounded inputs and percentage arithmetic.
edits.zh: 这里值得保留的是数量级，而不是小数点后的一位。规模膨胀得如此夸张，恰恰提醒人：一项可以反复循环记账的余额，不能直接当成同等规模的外来资本或者真实信贷需求。
edits.en: What matters here is the order of magnitude, not a decimal place. Expansion on this scale is a warning: a balance that can be repeatedly recycled cannot simply be read as an equal amount of outside capital or real credit demand.

edits.reason: Add returns over a common period; do not add an interest amount to a dimensionless rate.
edits.zh: 对同一期间、同一本金口径，存款方的收益率约等于存款利息除以本金，再加分给他的 COMP 的同期市值除以符合条件的资本；需要年化时，两项必须采用一致的期间和换算方法。
edits.en: For the same period and principal basis, a depositor’s return is approximately interest divided by principal, plus the period’s market value of allocated COMP divided by eligible capital. Annualization must use a consistent period and method for both components.

edits.reason: Match reward and borrowing rates over the same period before comparing them.
edits.zh: 而借款人的净成本率，约等于同一期间的借款利率，减去借款方奖励的同期市值除以未偿借款；两项同样要用一致的期间，才能比较。
edits.en: A borrower’s net cost rate is approximately the borrowing rate for a given period minus the market value of borrower rewards over that same period divided by outstanding debt. The periods must match before the two can be compared.

edits.reason: Ownership transfers can be on-chain; actual controller identity and motives need not be.
edits.zh: 而谁实际控制那把私钥、为什么选择某个时刻交权，不一定能从链上独立查清。权限移交和移交之前的部分操作可以留下链上记录，实际控制者的身份与动机却还需要另外的材料。
edits.en: Who actually controls the key, and why control is transferred at a particular moment, may not be independently established on-chain. A transfer of authority and some preceding actions can leave on-chain records; the controller’s identity and motives still require other evidence.

edits.reason: Not all searcher income comes from ordinary traders and not all gas goes to validators.
edits.zh: 把这四头合起来，费用与价值转移要分开看：交易者付手续费和 gas，也可能因执行劣化让搜索者获利；套利利润还可能对应 LP 的库存损失。gas 的分配又取决于当时的协议，不能全算成验证者收入，例如以太坊实施 EIP-1559 后基础费会被销毁，而优先费和部分额外支付流向出块与排序的一侧。
edits.en: Across these four groups, explicit payments and value transfers must be separated. Traders pay fees and gas and may lose value to searchers through worse execution; arbitrage profits can also correspond to LP inventory losses. Gas allocation depends on the protocol at the time: under Ethereum’s EIP-1559, the base fee is burned, while priority fees and some additional payments flow to the block-production and ordering side.

edits.reason: The original study labels a motive conjecture, not verified identity or intent.
edits.zh: 这些地址不能直接当成同样数量的独立使用者。高度重复的小额存款提示了某种共同策略；作者把等待可能空投列为最合理的猜测，而没有因此核实每个地址背后的人数与动机。
edits.en: These addresses cannot simply be counted as an equal number of independent users. The repeated tiny deposits suggest a shared strategy. The author’s best conjecture was anticipation of a possible airdrop—not verification of the people or motives behind every address.

edits.reason: Do not infer intentions from address counts.
edits.zh: 第七篇里说过地址不是人。这里更进一步：同样一个人可以用许多地址安排自己的参与，而链上计数本身不能告诉我们，他为什么这样做。
edits.en: The seventh essay said that an address is not a person. Here the point goes further: one person can organize participation through many addresses, while counting them does not itself reveal why.

edits.reason: Distinguish the large-address category from the top-100 ranking across all categories, including contracts; retain both published figures.
edits.zh: 剔除之后剩下 161,569 个地址。论文分类中的小钱包占地址数的 99.7%，而只占美元存款的 16%；256 个大钱包地址占美元存款的 30.5%。这里的大钱包类别与另列的智能合约类别分开。若把所有类别合在一起排序，前 100 个地址占存款的约 75%，其中也可能有汇集许多人资金的合约，不能把它们全叫作 100 个大户自然人。
edits.en: After exclusion, 161,569 addresses remained. The paper’s small-wallet category comprised 99.7% of addresses but 16% of dollar deposits; its 256 large-wallet addresses accounted for 30.5%. That category excludes separately classified smart contracts. Ranked across all categories, the top 100 addresses accounted for about 75% of deposits and could include contracts pooling many people’s funds—not simply 100 wealthy individuals.

edits.reason: Do not certify an error-free uninterrupted implementation history.
edits.zh: 那次压缩确实做成了，而且做得比它的许多批评者愿意承认的更彻底。它已经持续运转了五年多，日常兑换不需要有人每天开门；这不等于每一次实现都不会出错。
edits.en: The compression did succeed, more thoroughly than many critics acknowledge. It has operated for more than five years, without someone opening a counter each day for routine swaps. That does not certify every implementation as error-free.

edits.reason: Some interfaces display price impact and estimated gas; a quoted fee is not the complete cost.
edits.zh: 但单独那个费率不显示完整成本：曲线上的价格冲击、LP 的无常损失、夹击和 gas，都不是同一栏里的东西。有的界面会另列价格冲击和预估 gas；即使列了，你看到的费率年化也仍然不等于利润。
edits.en: That fee alone does not display the full cost. Price impact, LP impermanent loss, sandwiching, and gas belong to different accounts. Some interfaces separately show price impact and estimated gas; even then, an annualized fee figure is not profit.

edits.reason: Distinguish pre-trade estimates from costs depending on future execution or exit.
edits.zh: 其中一部分可以在按下确认之前估算，另一部分要等交易执行甚至退出仓位时才知道；估计值和最终结果，不应放在同一层上。
edits.en: Some costs can be estimated before confirmation; others become known only at execution or when a position is closed. An estimate and a realized result are not the same thing.

edits.reason: Price impact and gas estimates may change before inclusion.
edits.zh: 这四样东西的时间性质不一样。价格冲击和 gas 可以事先估计，但到打包执行之前仍可能变化；夹击与排序要看实际执行，无常损失则还取决于之后的价格路径和退出时点。
edits.en: These four costs have different timing. Price impact and gas can be estimated beforehand but may change before inclusion; sandwiching and ordering depend on execution, while impermanent loss also depends on subsequent prices and the time of exit.

edits.reason: Repair the inverted timing claim while preserving the essay’s point.
edits.zh: 而这一条比它看上去更一般。前面几篇里的余项，有的是被标准留在管辖之外，有的是没进代码，有的是没有人被派去量。这一次是第四种：报价屏幕亮着时，决定最终结果的一些事还没有发生；等到结果可以结算，人已经离开了那一刻的报价屏幕。
edits.en: The point is broader than it appears. Earlier remainders lay outside a standard’s jurisdiction, outside the code, or outside anyone’s assigned measurement. Here is a fourth kind: while the quote is on screen, some events determining the final outcome have not happened. When that outcome can be settled, the reader has already left that moment’s quote screen.

edits.reason: A verifiable mathematical rule is not proof of a flawless historical deployment.
edits.zh: 那条曲线的数学约束本身可以被清楚地核验。
edits.en: The curve’s mathematical constraint can itself be checked clearly.

edits.reason: Remove an unsupported universal no-error history.
edits.zh: 输入多少、输出多少，任何人都可以按公开规则自己算一遍。这个可重算的约束，是它持续运转的技术基础，而不是所有代码和每个区块都绝不出错的证明。
edits.en: Anyone can recalculate inputs and outputs under the public rule. That reproducible constraint is a technical basis for continued operation—not proof that every piece of code and every block has always been error-free.

edits.reason: The actual v2 check uses fee-adjusted balances, as explained in section one.
edits.zh: 对实际的 v2 兑换，要先作手续费调整，再检查新余额的乘积不小于原储备的乘积；通过才更新，否则回滚。这是这一道检查的核心，不是合约全部检查只有这一句。
edits.en: An actual v2 swap first adjusts balances for fees, then checks that their product is at least the old reserves’ product. Only then are reserves updated; otherwise it reverts. That is the core of this check, not the contract’s only check.

edits.reason: Checks are specified by a particular feed and integration, not universally enforced by base-chain consensus.
edits.zh: 链上真正知道的是：某一个地址，或者某一组地址，按照某一套协议，在某一个时刻，提交了表示 65,000 的数据；并且通过了那套 feed 与使用方实际配置的检查。签名、聚合、时效和权限是否都被检查，要逐个实现看，不能由上链二字直接推出。
edits.en: What the chain actually knows is that an address or group submitted data representing 65,000 at a particular time under a protocol, and that it passed the checks actually configured in that feed and its integration. Whether signatures, aggregation, freshness, and permissions are all checked depends on the implementation; being on-chain alone does not establish it.

edits.reason: Oracle service and incentives can be priced; pricing does not make consensus certify external truth.
edits.zh: 这一次，数据服务和纠错激励仍然可以定价；但付出费用，不能让共识本身替外部事实担保。
edits.en: Here, data services and incentives to correct errors can still be priced. Paying for them does not make consensus itself a guarantor of external facts.

edits.reason: Five correlated sources among eleven do not by themselves mathematically control a median.
edits.zh: 于是 11 个来源并不等于 11 个独立的风险因子。不过，5 个可操纵来源也不等于单凭数量就占有中位数：结果还取决于其他报价的位置和更新状态，以及具体的聚合与调用路径。
edits.en: Eleven sources therefore did not mean eleven independent risk factors. But five manipulable sources do not, by count alone, control the median: the result also depends on the other quotes’ values and update states and on the precise aggregation and call paths.

edits.reason: Locally normal behavior is not proof that both parties fulfilled all end-to-end duties.
edits.zh: 于是就出现了这一节真正要说的那件事：上游采取保护性的停更，下游却仍把旧值当作可用报价。各自的局部规则可以照常运转，整体的风险仍然失控；这不能反过来证明两边都没有做错，也不能替任何一方免除应当承担的责任。
edits.en: Here is the point: upstream updates stopped protectively, while the downstream protocol still treated the old value as usable. Local rules could continue operating while end-to-end risk escaped control. That does not prove both sides were faultless or release either from duties it should bear.

edits.reason: A gap in implemented checks is a risk-design and responsibility question, not universal absence of duties.
edits.zh: 这条链上的局部动作未必违反各自已经写下的程序，却不等于从源头到使用方的责任已经接上。谁应当检查停更、谁能够暂停风险敞口，仍是设计和责任安排要回答的问题。
edits.en: Local actions may comply with their written procedures without connecting responsibility from source to user. Who should detect a halted feed, and who can pause the exposure, remain questions for system design and allocation of duties.

edits.reason: Freshness and fallback checks can detect a validly signed but stale value.
edits.zh: 一个协议如果被喂了错误的价格，可能通过多源交叉检查发现异常。继续读到最后那个正确过的价格时，签名和格式则可能仍然有效；若只检查这些，它就会漏过停更。加入新鲜度、备用来源和断路器检查，能处理另一部分风险。
edits.en: Cross-checking sources may reveal a false price. When a protocol keeps reading a value that was once correct, its signature and format may remain valid; checking only those can miss a halted feed. Freshness checks, fallback sources, and circuit breakers address another part of the risk.

edits.reason: Timestamp checks are important but not the only possible protection.
edits.zh: 最直接的一问，是这个数什么时候更新；使用方还可以设置超时、备用来源、异常值检查和暂停条件。保护措施必须实际进入集成设计，不能只依靠数据源地址看起来可信。
edits.en: The most direct question is when the value was updated. The integration can also specify timeouts, fallback sources, anomaly checks, and pause conditions. Protections must actually enter the design; a trusted-looking source address is not enough.

edits.reason: Do not equate absence of an active attacker with absence of design error or responsibility.
edits.zh: 上一节里，是有人主动去改变了一个可以被改变的数。这一节里，即使没有人主动捏造新报价，遗漏停更处理也足以让钱流走；没有主动攻击，不等于没有设计失误或责任。
edits.en: In the previous section, someone actively changed a manipulable number. Here, even without anyone fabricating a new quote, failure to handle halted updates could let assets leave. Absence of an active attacker does not mean absence of design error or responsibility.

edits.reason: A missing check does not prove that this failure is inherently undetectable or always harder.
edits.zh: 而后一类容易被忽略，正因为它可能不触发那些只看签名、格式和数值范围的既有检查；难点不是原则上无从防范，而是有没有把停更当成必须处理的状态。
edits.en: The latter is easy to overlook because it may not trigger existing checks limited to signatures, format, and value ranges. The difficulty is not that prevention is impossible in principle, but whether halted updates are treated as a state the system must handle.

edits.reason: Limit a uniqueness statement to the materials actually consulted.
edits.zh: 这是本次查阅的这几起事故材料里，少数能落到一个具体自然人的记录之一。
edits.en: Among the materials consulted here on these incidents, this is one of the few records that reaches a specific individual.

edits.reason: Do not claim the literature contains exactly one individual account.
edits.zh: 本次材料里能够落到自然人的具体记录，包括法院卷宗里那次失败的提款尝试。
edits.en: The concrete individual-level evidence in the materials consulted includes that failed withdrawal attempt in the court record.

edits.reason: There are engineering approaches; the limit is consensus alone guaranteeing external truth.
edits.zh: 这一次，没有一个仅靠共识就能保证外部事实为真的办法。
edits.en: Here, no method based on consensus alone can guarantee the truth of an external fact.

edits.reason: Do not imply every chain natively validates feed freshness and reporter thresholds.
edits.zh: 链上的合约可以验签名、人数和更新时间；究竟验了哪些、验得够不够，要看 feed 和使用方实际写下的规则。
edits.en: On-chain contracts can check signatures, participant thresholds, and update times. Which checks are performed, and whether they suffice, depend on the rules actually implemented by the feed and its users.

review_scope: Main agent read complete Chinese EP06–10 and complete English EP06–08. ES/EN reviewer additionally read complete English EP06–10; DE/FR and JA/KO reviewers read their full manuscripts. Root source decisions preserve all body sections and examples, use targeted primary-source checks and internal consistency checks, and do not claim an exhaustive historical or legal audit. August 2026 cutoff retained.
